name: Durghatana Mein Chikitsa Sahaayata Yojana
benefit: - To the registered beneficiaries, medical assistance of ₹ 20,000/- or the actual expenditure incurred on the treatment, whichever is less, will be provided.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Chhattisgarh state.
1. It is mandatory for construction workers to be registered in any district.
1. Must have completed 90 days as a laborer in the board.
